evidence.stated_factor: Uneven feature adoption with steep drop-off in spreadsheets and slide generation

evidence.title: Past the stall: Why M365 Copilot rollouts plateau and the governed path through

evidence.stated_factor: Permission inheritance flaws and RAG architecture vulnerabilities causing data exposure

approval.summary:
- **Copilot Segment**: Desktop copilots accelerate individual administrative tasks, but enterprise-wide scaling falters on permissions hygiene and post-rollout engagement decay.
- **Workflow Segment**: Autonomous workflow agents unlock measurable P&L gains in high-volume operations, though adoption requires process redesign and verifiable auditability.
- **Key Shifts**: Enterprise priorities have pivoted from copilot seat provisioning to remediating tenant data oversharing and jagged reliability.
- **Production Milestones**: Workflow agents in supply chain, financial crime, and customer ops have advanced from experimental pilots into high-volume straight-through production under heightened regulatory scrutiny.
- **Evidence Base**: 7 industry profiles supported by 441 sources and 1,572 verified claims.
